_comment: 物品表。加新物品：照 glowing_wood 抄一条。rarity 取 common / uncommon / rare / epic / legendary；burn = 燃烧值；icon = 图（res:// 路径，背包里按整数倍放大）；personal = 私人物品（不能烧掉，比如照片、信）。文字中英两套。desc_fixed（可选）= 修好以后换的描述（音乐盒：剧本里 flag musicbox_fixed 之后用）。森林章节的私人物品 burn 先填 0，以后飞行段再给燃料值。desc_from_tag（可选）= 描述后面接上带这个 tag 的日记条目（大象的画）。added = 描述是补写的（不是剧情姐原文），给她审。第三版的任务物品（木板、罐子、松脂、弹簧、阀门、要送还的三件）personal=true、burn=0：不能烧。 category = material（燃料材料）/ keepsake（纪念品）/ quest（任务物品）。纪念品的 keepsake_burn = 以后飞行段烧掉它给的燃料（60~120），burn_note = 烧掉时晨的一句话（先空）；森林里不烧纪念品，所以 personal 和 burn 保持原样，燃料计算不变。 第六版（10-29 合订稿）：communicator = 通讯器（quest、personal、不能烧，背包里点开是聊天界面，联系人和记录见 data/phone.json）；日记里夹的回忆页不是独立物品，是日记里 tag=memory 的两条（合订稿里烧日记时只留下首页，回忆页跟着日记走）；fixed_part = 修好的推进器零件（弥洛包好、回飞机时装回去）。

desc.en: A branch from Jupiter's forest that never quite stopped burning. Warm to the touch, and it smells a little like rain.
desc.zh: 木星森林里一截一直没有熄灭的树枝。摸起来暖暖的，闻起来有一点雨的味道。

desc.en: A piece that came off the ship in the crash. The edges are still hot.
desc.zh: 坠毁时从飞机上掉下来的碎片。边上还是热的。

desc.en: Resin that dripped down a tree trunk. Sticky, and it burns well.
desc.zh: 从树干上流下来的树脂，黏黏的，很好烧。

desc.en: A bone-dry branch. Hard to find anything dry in this forest.
desc.zh: 一截干透的树枝。森林里难得有不潮的东西。

desc.en: Four legs, a long nose and two ears. A friend drew it for Chen once. One line by the nose has been redrawn. On the back: "Next time, let's go see the elephant in the clouds together." Chen keeps it folded small. A crease runs across the elephant's face, and it always needs smoothing out.
desc.zh: 画上是四条腿、长鼻子和两只耳朵，是朋友以前画给晨看的。鼻子旁边有一道改过的笔迹，背面写着：「下次一起去看看云层里的大象。」晨把纸折得很小，折痕穿过大象的脸，展开时总要用手抹几下。

desc.en: A search result tucked inside the drawing: "No species matches this description." Beside it, in Chen's tiny writing: "Try again."
desc.zh: 夹在画里的查询结果：「未找到符合描述的物种」。晨在旁边写了一个很小的「再查」。

desc.en: Hundreds of identical trips through the same gates. The last one is the day before leaving. Tucked in the sleeve is a seat map the two of them drew, marking which car gets the afternoon sun. One seat is crossed out, with a note: "Sunny, sure, but so windy every time the doors open."
desc.zh: 里面有几百条相同的进出站记录，最后一条是出发前一天。卡套内侧夹着两人一起画的座位图，标着哪节车厢下午能晒到太阳；其中一个位置被划掉，旁边写着：「这里晒是晒，门一开风也好大。」

desc.en: The bakery they always went to. The friend stands by the window, holding a paper bag. On the back: "Half price the next day, but you always want it the same day." Below, added later by Chen: "Same day, the ends are crusty."
desc.zh: 拍的是他们常去的那家面包店，朋友站在窗边，手里拎着纸袋。背面留着一句：「第二天便宜一半，你非要当天吃。」晨后来在下面补了几个字：「当天的边是脆的。」

desc.en: Bought on a trip with that friend. On the way home, squeezed into a corner of the train, she held it on her lap, listened once, and wound it again. Chen hummed along, always half a beat late where the tune turns. Now the melody stops halfway. Chen has a habit of tapping the bottom twice.
desc.zh: 和那位朋友出游时一起买的。回程挤在车厢角落，朋友把盒子放在膝上，听了一遍，又拧紧发条。晨跟着哼，到了转音的地方总慢半拍。打开以后，旋律只响到一半。晨习惯在盒底轻拍两下。

desc_fixed.en: Bought on a trip with that friend. Where the tune turns, Chen still pauses, as if letting the person beside go first. Milo cleaned out the grit, and the melody plays to the end now. She said: stop smacking it.
desc_fixed.zh: 和那位朋友出游时一起买的。如今再听到转音的地方，晨还是会等一下，像等旁边的人先出声。弥洛清掉了里面的碎屑，旋律能走到最后了。她说，下次别老拍它。

desc.en: Marked with the forest, the river and the clouds. Beside the destination, an old note: "Next time, let's go see the elephant in the clouds together." Chen once underlined "together." The map's been folded so often that the line has started to break.
desc.zh: 标着森林、河流和云层。终点旁留着一句旧批注：「下次一起去看看云层里的大象。」晨在「一起」下面画过一道线，地图折了太多次，那道线已经有些断开。

desc.en: It has a shallow groove just right for a thumb. As a kid, Chen insisted it glowed, and watched it under the covers for nights on end. It turned out it only looks brighter when wet. Chen kept it anyway.
desc.zh: 表面有一道适合放拇指的浅槽。小时候，晨坚持它会发光，躲进被子看了好几晚。后来发现只有沾着水时看起来亮一些，后来也一直收着。

desc.en: Chen's journal. The first page has just one line: "I have to find the elephant, because" and then a lot of blank space, with a slightly darker ink dot after "because." Tucked behind it is a page of memories, undated.
desc.zh: 晨的日记。第一页只写了一句：「我一定要找到大象，因为」，后面留着大片空白，「因为」后面有一个稍深的墨点。后面夹着一页回忆，日期空着。

desc.en: The communicator from the luggage, still open to that friend's chat. Nothing has come after Chen's last message.
desc.zh: 行李里的通讯器，停在那位朋友的聊天窗口。晨发出的最后一条消息后面一直空着。

desc.en: A part taken off the thruster. The deer says it was broken before the ship came down.
desc.zh: 从推进器上拆下来的零件。鹿说，它掉下来以前就坏了。

desc.en: Milo checked the retaining ring and wrapped it up herself. When putting it back in the ship, follow the same order.
desc.zh: 弥洛检查过固定环、亲手包好的零件。装回飞机的时候，照着刚才的顺序来。

desc.en: A water pump Milo fixed. It's not for Chen. Chen's just carrying it partway.
desc.zh: 弥洛修好的水泵。不是给晨的，只是让晨帮忙拿一段路。

desc.en: Milo's friend left it before she went. She said it might sprout under the clouds. The packet has been replaced; the old one is still at the bottom of Milo's box.
desc.zh: 弥洛的朋友走前留下的，说在云层下面可能会发芽。装种子的袋子换过，旧袋还压在弥洛的盒底。

desc.en: Kept with the seed: "Don't bury it too deep. Water it a little first. Don't keep digging it up to check."
desc.zh: 和种子放在一起：「不要埋太深。先浇一点水。别总挖出来看。」

desc.en: The postcard from under Milo's glass, postmarked from the river city. No dust on it, no curled corners. She said: the handwriting's bad, ask if you can't read it.
desc.zh: 压在弥洛玻璃下面的明信片，邮戳来自河流城市。纸上没有灰，边角也没有卷。她说：字不好看，认不出来就问。

desc.en: A plank pulled off the old shop's rotten shelves. Still fairly sturdy.
desc.zh: 从旧商店烂掉的货架上拆下来的木板。还算结实。

desc.en: A small jar from Milo, for sap. Don't spill it.
desc.zh: 弥洛给的小罐子，装松脂用。别弄洒了。

desc.en: Sap from the old pine's wound, so sticky the lid barely turns. For plugging the thruster leak.
desc.zh: 老松树伤口上流下来的松脂，黏得盖子都不好拧。修推进器堵漏用。

desc.en: An old spring that still has some bounce. For the thruster.
desc.zh: 一根旧弹簧，还弹得起来。修推进器用。

desc.en: A valve part taken off an abandoned signal box. Rusty, but it still turns.
desc.zh: 废弃信号箱上拆下来的阀门零件。锈了一层，还能拧。

desc.en: A radio Milo fixed. The name tag says: Snack Stall. The owner moved away.
desc.zh: 弥洛修好的收音机，挂着姓名牌：小吃棚。主人搬走了。

desc.en: A signpost that spins on its own. The name tag says: Clearing. It's looking for the way.
desc.zh: 一只会自己转的路标，挂着姓名牌：空地。它在找路。

desc.en: An oil lamp Milo gave a new wick. Out of oil. Name tag: Roadside Hut.
desc.zh: 弥洛换过灯芯的油灯，没有油了。姓名牌：路边的小屋。
